Drift Away

  • 4 Bedrooms
  • 3.5 Baths
  • 10 Sleeps
  • 2404 sqft
Favorite

HOME HIGHLIGHTS: ▪️ 3 KING bedrooms with TVs, all with private baths ▪️ Bunk room and additional living space upstairs with TV for the kids ▪️ Access to community pool ▪️ Beautifully decorated throughout with new furnishings ▪️ 2 Bikes ▪️ Backyard entertaining area with grill ▪️ Fully stocked kitchen ▪️ Walking distance to Red Fish Village and several Blue Mountain restaurant favorites! ▪️ Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: → Optional Cancellation Protection →Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). Drift Away is located in the heart of Blue Mountain in a newer community. 5 minute walk to the beach, Drift Away has 4BR and sleeps 10 comfortably. Floor 1: ✦ Gorgeous Kitchen open to Great room and Dining area with Huge TV ✦ King Suite with Private full bath ✦ 1/2 Bath ✦ Outdoor access to front porch with Adirondack chairs and back yard Floor 2: ✦ King Suite, TV, Private on suite bath ✦ Bunk room with 4 twins ✦ Second living room with large TV- perfect hangout for the kids! ✦ King master suite with large bathroom, separate tub and shower, TV and direct access to private balcony Must be 25 years old to rent. Sorry, no pets! FREE WIFI
